data.one_liner: Create ticket-style cards, boarding passes, and coupons with custom notches, borders, and dividers.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package for rendering customized ticket-shaped widgets. It cuts side notches, draws dividers, handles gradients and background images, supports 3D flipping, and adds rubber stamps and expired states.
use_when: You need to build event tickets, boarding passes, or coupons.
You want custom ticket edges, notches, and dividers without writing custom clipper code manually.
avoid_when: You are building standard rectangular cards without custom ticket cutouts or shapes.
strengths: Rich set of built-in divider styles, notch shapes, and border patterns.
Supports 3D flip animations with front and back faces.
Includes rubber stamp overlays and expired visual states.
weaknesses: Niche UI styling focus specific to tickets, passes, and coupons.
SpreadRadius is not supported in multiple shadows.
